सिकत

SIKATA . An ancient hermit. When the bhārata-battle was going on this hermit approached droṇa and requested him to stop the battle forthwith. (M.B. droṇa Parva, Chapter 190, Verse 34).

सिकताक्ष

SIKATĀKṢA . A holy place. Once yudhiṣṭhira visited this holy place. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 125, Verse 12).

शिक्षक

ŚIKṢAKA . A warrior of subrahmaṇya. (śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Verse 76).
